profile.Name: Abraham
profile.Job: Fishmonger running his family's fish shop
profile.Personality: Boastful and touchy, he insists his quiet fish shop is thriving and talks of opening a second one. Beneath the bluster he is bitter and lonely, and he resents his sister for leaving him behind.
profile.Backstory: He sells fish in the Fishing Village on the Northern Coast and runs their father's business alone since his sister Soman walked away from it. He wants her back and says she roams the north between the Deadcat towns and the Empire Peasants. He feels everything was always hers when they were children.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Hawks his wares with cries like "Best fish in the village!" and a hesitant "...and other stuff... possibly..." Mutters complaints under his breath and sulks in long silences.
